title: Every integer shift of the actual condensed Tate twist is bounded constructible when ell is invertible on the scheme.
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime and $X$ an arbitrary scheme. Suppose that the image of $\ell$ in the residue field $\kappa(x)$ [def-weil-residue-field] is invertible for every $x\in X$. Put $B_X=p_X^*\underline\Omega$, where $\underline\Omega=\mathrm{Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj}(\ell)$ is the finite-subextension-valued condensed algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and let $B_X(d)$ and $\mathrm{tateTwistDerived}(X,\ell,d)=B_X(d)[0]$ be exactly the internal-module constructions of [def-pur-condensed-tate-twists]. For every $d,n\in\mathbf Z$, the object
$$\mathrm{tateTwistDerived}(X,\ell,d)[n]\in D(\operatorname{Mod}_{B_X})$$
is bounded constructible in the precise sense of [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-complexes]: its cohomology vanishes outside a finite interval and every cohomology module is constructible in the finite-stratification, locally-finitely-presented sense of [def-sfb-constructible-module]. No quasi-compactness, Noetherianity, finite-type or finite-field hypothesis on $X$ is imposed.

proof.text: The residue-field invertibility assumption makes ell a unit in every stalk: use IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit and the nonzero image of an invertible element in the residue field. The ringed-space stalk criterion then makes ell a unit in Gamma(X,O_X). Apply [lem-poincare-first-twist-pullback-local-line] to id_X to obtain a cover and a basis for the actual first twist after the two raw inverse images that occur in the constructibility predicate.

For the composite of the two monoidal mapMod functors, induction identifies the image of tateTwistNat(n) with the regular module: at zero use the inverse unit comparison; at the successor use the inverse tensor comparison, the inductive basis and first-twist basis, followed by the left unitor. This is powers_image_regular in the delivered Lean file and uses exactly the recursive definition in [def-pur-condensed-tate-twists].

For a weakly etale inverse image, the ambient sheaf internal-Hom comparison is an isomorphism, and inverse image preserves the equalizer imposing R-linearity. The concrete module internal Hom Mod.ihom' is the right adjoint of relative tensor, hence agrees with the categorical ihom by uniqueness of right adjoints. Apply Mod.isIso_mapIhom'Hom with identity scalar change and remove that identity change using Mod.comapId. This is nonempty_pullback_ihom. Apply it to id_X and each cover morphism, then use the positive-power basis, the unit comparison and MonoidalClosed.unitIsoSelf. The negative signed twist is therefore regular on the same cover.

Use the single stratum X with identity immersion. Its image is constructible and locally closed. Each local image of the signed twist is regular by the preceding two steps. A regular module is the cokernel of the zero map from the free module of rank zero to the free module of rank one, using biproductUniqueIso and cokernelZeroIsoTarget. These are finite presentations for precisely the raw double pullbacks of [def-sfb-constructible-module], so the signed twist is constructible without any quasi-compactness or Noetherian assumption.

Apply [lem-poincare-constructible-shift-single] to this constructible signed twist and arbitrary n. By [def-pur-condensed-tate-twists], its degree-zero single is exactly tateTwistDerived. This proves the stated boundedConstructible predicate, including d=0, positive and negative d, every n and the empty scheme.
